decision: Selected the centroid of Dallas Central Appraisal District parcel 00000778060000000 (owner DA12 LLC, mailed to 1 Lagoon Dr, Redwood City CA; situs 1550 W Mockingbird Ln, Dallas 75235; 17.6768 legal acres) as the campus locator for Equinix's DA12 data center.
